summary: Four items cleared the bar. The strongest publication is the European Parliament study on Open Science and generative AI. No substantial new Germany-specific OA policy appeared, although that study was coordinated from Kiel University.
signal: The week's common theme is Open Science as governed infrastructure. AI provenance, research-assessment data, federated services, and FP10 funding are being treated as connected design problems. For comparative policy coding it helps to distinguish openness of outputs from openness and ownership of underlying infrastructure, mechanisms for verifying provenance and integrity, implementation capacity, and governance authority over standards, services, and funding.

notes: SAMPLE ISSUE: pre-seeded from curated human source briefs dated 2026-10-23, not from the automated feed collection.
